scope: One fresh agent-authored original-character compiled C# route workflow, with separate original ownership/policy/provenance reviews and an independent Windows headless warm/cold/relocated native campaign. A separate post-workflow nonfocusable Windows background observation captures the original menu and zero-input elapsed play.

input_context.scope: Generic public API documentation, Python and managed SDK sources, selected compiler dependencies, task/schema and original licensed inputs. No game implementation or sample solution was supplied.
input_context.reasoning_policy: CLI default with user configuration ignored and no effort override.
input_context.model_identity_limit: Explicit CLI model selection is recorded. The event format does not independently identify the serving model.

task.requirements: Inspect/import the intact original Knight, derive controller fitting from native rest bounds, and author a fixed court with an ordered two-pad signalling route. Native Begin/Save/Load UI callbacks and named logical input drive compiled gameplay. Idle/Running_A follows committed displacement in every phase, including blocked movement and Complete.
task.input_scope: Native logical Held/Pressed/Released sampling; physical devices were not tested.

retained_failures.outcome: A UI read omitted a required tick, a save-status key was misread, and a save probe omitted an active-UI guard. Each error closed naturally; the agent corrected its scripts within the same original turn.

retained_failures.stage: First export and its containing script
retained_failures.outcome: Native directory publication returned Windows error 5 and terminal exit 4; the script assertion failed. After this known terminal failure, the second export used a new output directory and succeeded. Both submissions and all receipts remain.
One absolute script selector was rejected before a lifetime started; a portable selector was then admitted.

original_fresh_workflow.recovery_scope: All four failed script lifetimes are retained: three harness errors and the script containing the failed first export. No parent game/source repair, old game reuse, failure deletion or acceptance weakening was used. Original producer receipts remain unchanged; the final verdict joins separate independent scopes.

content.author: Kay Lousberg
content.intake: Exact original source/license copies were retained. Native source inspection and guarded import used the same immutable source and returned parsed-model fingerprint in separate owned lifetimes. Complete take names/indices and cooked bytes joined the resulting project and exports. Native rest bounds supplied controller height and rig offset; import diagnostics were retained.

new_artifact.classification: Fresh original Native AOT publication, guarded project adoption and completed standalone export.
new_artifact.source_to_artifact_scope: Delivered C# bytes match their original creation event. The admitted publisher reports the selected project/type, completed native-code generation and exact new image/descriptor; guarded adoption and export retain those identities. This is not a hermetic or reproducible compiler-input attestation.

independent_native_campaign.causal_method: Each checked single-tick step has fresh complete before/after observations joined by native revision/session/tick. Controls invalidate prior observations. Missing, stale or mismatched pairs fail; no ticks are excluded.
independent_native_campaign.profile_inspection: Warm and cold source owners request input.inspect with read_only:true. The frozen complete candidate file membership is preserved.

checkpoint.continuation: Fresh cold source and relocated bundled host restore and finish the route. Subsequent complete saves retain all fields; selected later continuation is not described as whole-state equality with the earlier partial checkpoint.

relocation.file_inventory_scope: Entire original workspace and products trees: 688 files, with no exclusions.

separate_prerequisite_qualification.scope: Independent installed-tool consumers and file-only setup establish the selected inputs. Their results are separate from the fresh game and its native campaign.

installed_nativeaot_public_consumer.scope: New installed-pack publication/adoption/export and complete source/relocated save continuation; no CoreCLR game-consumer qualification inferred.

preceding_original_fresh_0_0_214.reason: Inspection added an empty coordination sidecar beyond the original complete file-membership baseline. Its original result was not repaired or regraded.

earlier_assisted_fixture.classification: Earlier assisted adaptation and separate portable source rebuild, with its original fresh attempt still failed.
earlier_assisted_fixture.scope: Those existing public files and original classifications remain unchanged. They are not the new fresh215 source/image/workflow.

reproduction.scope: These public sources document and exercise generic installed-tool and exported-game boundaries. Fresh task originals and independent campaign records are retained under the identified hashes; their complete harness and new game source are not distributed by this evidence file. The older public assisted fixture is identified separately.
reproduction.content_notice: Keep the original character license with distributed source assets and include runtime/gameplay dependency notices.

limits: One bounded task and one selected CLI model run do not establish a model success rate, general agent capability or representative engine performance.

The original authoring and independent gameplay campaign are headless. The separate two-frame background observation does not qualify full-route rendered play, GUI interaction, physical devices, appearance quality or audio.
Whole-engine/Alpha completion, broad asset conformance, crowds and production scalability remain unqualified.
Six settled full-rig comparisons do not qualify every take or exact active inertial-pose equality.
Complete immediate checkpoint equality and selected later continuation are distinct scopes. Independent failed-save callback coverage is not claimed.
Same-host source-independent relocation is not clean-machine installation, OS isolation or full engine-checkout absence.
Empty natural Job accounting and retained exit codes do not establish every OS process exit cause or global native actor absence.
Selected source/tool/pack identities do not pin every transitive SDK/tool/cache byte. Matching runtime/module/SDK artifacts are required; ABI labels alone are insufficient.
Earlier unqualified workflows, failed producer attempts and assisted recoveries keep their original classifications.

separate_background_visual_observation.phase: After the original headless workflow and native campaign, using its unchanged final bundled CLI and Native AOT image.

illustration.conversion: Lossless original BMP RGB channels to PNG RGB; unused alpha omitted. No crop, rescale or content edits.

separate_background_visual_observation.scope: Two renderer readbacks in a nonfocusable native window; requires a display. Only compiled Begin and zero-input elapsed play were exercised. No route movement, Running_A locomotion, subjective rendering quality, listening, physical input or performance qualification.
separate_background_visual_observation.checkpoints: Disabled for this separate shared host; save/load was verified by the earlier independent headless campaign.

earlier_visual_setup.classification: Separate terminal preworker harness failure; public process trampoline interpreted Python -B as the script path. No engine or GPU launched. A new source/plan/output corrected that invocation; original failure remains unchanged.
